title: Isha Sannidhi Player v1.0.2
releaseNotes:
• Settings Dialog Visual Fix: Auto-scaled 90% screen width & responsive card container (fixes collapsed dialog on all phone screens & DPIs)
• Top Status Bar Overhaul: Split into clean 2-tier layout so Bluetooth speaker name is never truncated (shows full device name)
• Touch Target Optimization: Balanced equal-width action buttons for BT, DND, Bell Test, and Settings
• Accessibility font scaling support across all screen sizes
